name: Square Smartwatch, 2-inch Screen
description: A square smartwatch with a 2.01-inch colour screen, in grey-green or black, on a soft silicone strap. The listing gives Bluetooth and sports tracking; features beyond that are unconfirmed. For fitness use, not medical. Watch faces shown in the photos are sample displays.

source.notes: CNY 40 for 1 piece (about NGN 8,907.36 on the page), CNY 38 for 1000+; costed at 40, fx 8907.36/40 = 222.68. Same supplier as smart-band-m9-style. Store return rate NOT shown in the screenshots. 70+ want, 100+ reviews. 1688 title (S11, Dynamic Island, payment NFC, Huaqiangbei) NOT used. Attributes: brand LeWai, launched 2025, ladies/men/adult, screen 2.01. Packaged about 8.5 x 2.5 cm, 120 g (weight used as shipping weight, estimated). NOT claimed: NFC/payment, sapphire glass (AI strip, unverified), waterproofing, battery life, health sensors, medical. Bluetooth is in the 1688 title only; calling vs notifications unconfirmed. Battery not stated: lithium assumed, ships_by_air false (sea only). COUNTERFEIT RISK: case shape, crown and faces copy a well-known brand watch; owner must confirm with supplier that the unit shows no other brand's name or logo (startup screen, software, back, box). Excluded photos: Hello Kitty face (third-party IP), retail-box photo with another company's branding, pink-beige loop photo (soft, Chinese text, strap cut off). Colours: only grey-green and black have usable photos; a blue loop-strap style exists on the listing (first image) and a pink-beige loop style may exist, no clean photo. Photos are 800 px, enlarged 1.5x, slightly soft. OWNER DECISIONS 9 Nov 2026: counterfeit/lookalike risk explained; owner chose to proceed anyway and accepts the risk of brand complaints (supplier confirmation of no other brand marks not obtained); copy kept fully neutral. Price NGN 28000 (owner figure, changed from 25000 on 9 Nov 2026). Two colours only (Grey-green, Black) with current photos; owner saw the review sheet. Battery UNCONFIRMED: ships_by_air false (sea only) kept as the safe default.
